source.note: Each integration's README in decisio-examples at the commit that the recorded decisions come from; the version and check counts are also in decisio's README (Works with), which the build compares them with.

items.name: LangChain
items.baseUrl: no /v1: the class appends it; the base_url argument or TYPESAFE_BASE_URL
items.key: required: a dummy one works (ValueError without)
items.on422: TypeSafeUnprocessableEntityError, status 422, the server's detail on its body; not retried

snippet.text:
from langchain_typesafe import TypeSafeClassifier

classifier = TypeSafeClassifier(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8000", api_key="unused")

items.findings: Nothing broke. The class marks itself beta and logs a warning when built. It checks a question before sending (a choice with no options never reaches the server), and it drops the abstention fields, so a caller cannot tell that a server abstained.

items.name: Vercel AI SDK
items.baseUrl: must end in /v1 (http://host:port/v1); TYPESAFE_AI_BASE_URL is read when the provider is created
items.on422: APICallError, statusCode 422, not retryable; the message is the server's detail as JSON
items.timeout: none set (Node's fetch defaults apply); maxRetries 2 for retryable failures
items.findings: The one real difference from the other integrations is that baseURL needs /v1; without it the call fails loudly with a 404. The decision function throws if the chosen option is not the most probable one, which a server run with --abstain-option can produce; that case was emulated, not seen on a real abstaining server.

items.name: n8n
items.language: Node 22 (n8n 2.42 and later need Node 24 and were not run)
items.entry: the community node's credential and its decision nodes
items.baseUrl: the credential's Base URL, with no /v1; its default is the hosted address, so a self-hosted server changes it
items.key: required in the credential: any string
items.on422: a NodeApiError with httpCode 422 and the server's detail; with Continue on Error the detail is only in the item's error object
items.timeout: none unless added under Options; retries only on 429 and 529
items.findings: Nothing broke. Simplify Output is on by default and returns one flat value per question, so probabilities, legend and usage are dropped; turn it off to get the server's response unchanged.

items.name: TanStack AI
items.baseUrl: no /v1: the adapter posts to {baseURL}/v1/systemone; there is no environment variable for it
items.key: required: createTypesafeDecider takes it directly, typesafeDecider reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY
items.on422: an Error whose message starts "TypeSafe evaluate request failed: 422 Unprocessable Entity" and carries the body; not retried
items.timeout: none set (Node's fetch defaults apply); no retries

snippet.text:
import { createTypesafeDecider } from "@tanstack/ai-typesafe";

const adapter = createTypesafeDecider("decisio-gemma-4-31b-it-letters", "unused", { baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:8000" });

items.findings: Nothing broke. A base URL ending in /v1 posts to /v1/v1/systemone and fails with a 404, the opposite of the Vercel AI SDK's provider. The adapter drops the abstention fields and the x-decisio response headers.

items.name: Pipecat
items.baseUrl: no /v1; always pass base_url, because the default is the hosted address
items.on422: ClassifierError "HTTP 422"; the server's detail is discarded

snippet.text:
from pipecat.classifiers.jev import JevClient

client = JevClient(api_key="unused", base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8000")

items.findings: Nothing broke. A 422 loses its reason (only "HTTP 422" is raised), the default timeout is short at 10 seconds, and the classifier's results leave out the abstention fields.
